findings.description: The /evaluations/{record_id} route (line 184) is defined before /evaluations/demo/{demo_id} (line 192). FastAPI matches routes in definition order, so requests to /api/evaluations/demo/strong_crispr will be caught by the generic {record_id} route and treated as a database lookup for record ID 'demo', returning 404 instead of serving the demo result.
findings.action: Move the demo route definition before the generic {record_id} route in evaluations.py to ensure it matches first.
